articles.summary: A quiet Pacific storm and a raging Atlantic hurricane present vastly different forecasting challenges. See how Silurian's GFT-C model provided critical, early predictions for both Henriette's peaceful dissipation and Erin's explosive intensification, showcasing the power of advanced machine learning to bring clarity to chaos.
articles.title: Henriette and Erin: Two Storms, Two Oceans, One Model GFT-C
